title: kramastotra — kram-p12-v12
question: From that complete Whole — oh, juice of great-joy-taste — You lead Your own power into difference, by Your will's spreading. Priceless Your freedom — praising this, Your utterly wonderful becoming-power, fear melted, I am Śiva-made.
